sloka: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्राप्ततन्नस्रबिन्दवः।दीप्ताभ्यामिव दीपाभ्यां सार्चिषः स्नेहबिन्दवः ।। ६.९३.२३ ।।
transliteration: tasya kruddhasya netrābhyāṁ prāptatannasrabindavaḥ।dīptābhyāmiva dīpābhyāṁ sārciṣaḥ snehabindavaḥ ।। 6.93.23 ।।

translations.english: Just as drops of oil drop from flaming lamps, tears dropped from his enraged flaming eyes.
